text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, we had a huge pillow fight
with everyone in the dorm, and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I fell asleep midway through, and next thing I knew, I was back in my room.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, which team won again?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I'll go ask someone. Might as well
plan for the next race while I'm at it... *yaaawn*.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer seemed to be having fun, though she looked quite sleepy.
